pre_deploy_command: test ! -e webapp/rust/target || { echo 'remove imported webapp/rust/target before deploy; Cargo uses the remote persistent cache' >&2; exit 1; }

build_commands.name: rust-release
build_commands.command: cache_dir=/home/isucon/.cache/isucon-cargo-target; sudo install -d -o isucon -g isucon -m 0755 "$cache_dir"; if ! sudo test -f "$cache_dir/.rustc_info.json" && sudo test -d "$ISUCON_DEPLOY_REMOTE_PATH/rust/target"; then sudo -u isucon cp -a "$ISUCON_DEPLOY_REMOTE_PATH/rust/target/." "$cache_dir/"; fi; cd "$ISUCON_DEPLOY_STAGING_PATH/rust"; sudo -u isucon env CARGO_TARGET_DIR="$cache_dir" cargo build --release --locked; sudo -u isucon install -D -m 0755 "$cache_dir/release/replace-with-binary-name" "$ISUCON_DEPLOY_STAGING_PATH/rust/target/release/replace-with-binary-name"; test -x "$ISUCON_DEPLOY_STAGING_PATH/rust/target/release/replace-with-binary-name"
